Maya Chen: Quick sync re: Harbor pilot enrollment + feedback loop. Can we confirm who is running enablement sessions this week and if any accounts are blocked by security reviews? Need to flag renewal risk if onboarding slips.
Omar Patel: I can run enablement Wed 11am PT. Enrollment numbers: Harbor (5 seats), ZephyrCo (1 seat — stuck on IT review), Polarus (3 seats).
Ivy Park: Thanks. ZephyrCo blocking on certs/KMS access — sent checklist to their engs. I'll follow up today. playbook: https://redwood.ai/playbooks/pilot-enablement
Jared Brooks: Heads up: Harbor needs token rotation before we can onboard — sent credentials ticket to infra. @Ivy can you confirm required scopes?
Ivy Park: @Jared yep `inference.read`, `inference.stream`, `billing.view` — added to the checklist.
Maya Chen: Ok. Action items: Omar run Wed enablement; Ivy push cert checklist + confirm KMS; Jared follow up on tokens. Also propose a 3-question feedback form we email post-session. Template here: `docs/templates/pilot-feedback-3q.md`
Omar Patel: :thumbsup: I'll add session recording and short survey at end. Can we auto-send follow-up at +48h?
calendar-bot: Event created: Harbor pilot enablement — Wed 11:00 PT — invites sent to Harbor, Polarus, ZephyrCo
doc-bot: Committed update `pilot-runbook.md` (PR #342) — added KMS troubleshooting section
Maya Chen: Risk note: ZephyrCo's security lead asked for SOC2 attestation copy — CS to provide. If not resolved by next Tue, renewal discussion risk. @Omar please escalate.
Omar Patel: On it. Will loop in sales and legal today. If we need an exec briefing, suggest Thu.
Ivy Park: I'll draft the SOC2 packet and send to ZephyrCo this afternoon. Also copying a short checklist to share during enablement.
Maya Chen: :eyes: Thanks team. I'll track in the pilot board and ping for pre-read 24h before session.
Maya Chen: :white_check_mark:
